Vector geometry from `logseq/logseq`, `src/main/frontend/components/svg.cljs`, `logo`.
128 pt canvas, with padding around the original 21 × 21 view box. Light uses `#6F6F6F` and dark uses `#C8C8C8`.
Both appearances use 20% opacity. The app retints the dark mark for Solarized after reading the saved palette.
